name: Robledo de Chavela (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Robledo de Chavela (an oak and stars on yellow and a tower on red) between eight blue eight-pointed stars.
history: Robledo de Chavela adopted its arms and flag officially on 23 January 1992, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 20 March 1992; the flag is rectangular of proportions 2/3, red, bearing at its centre the crowned municipal arms and eight blue stars.

features.role: Robledo de Chavela arms — oak and stars on yellow, tower on red
eight stars around the arms, three above, two at the sides and three below
yellow field and crown of the arms
